newsitem.title: USA: Transco unit files to expand N.C. pipeline.
newsitem.headline: Transco unit files to expand N.C. pipeline.

text.p: Transco, a unit of Williams Cos Inc, said its Cardinal Operating Co filed on behalf of Cardinal Extension Co LLC an application to purchase and extend the existing 37-mile Cardinal Pipeline system in North Carolina.
Filed with the North Carolina Utilities Commission, the application seeks to extend the existing 24-inch intrastate pipeline 67 miles from Burlington to a point southeast of Raleigh.
The project is estimated to cost $98.3 million and to commence service on Nov. 1, 1999, Transco said.

The Cardinal Extension Co is a limited liability company that includes as members Transco's TransCardinal Co; PSNC Cardinal Co, a unit of Public Service Co of North Carolina; Piedmont Intrastate Pipeline Co, a unit of Piedmont Natural Gas Co Inc ; and NCNG Energy Corp, a unit of North Carolina Natural Gas Corp.
